SEARCH
Package domain.controller

Class DomainController

java.lang.Object
domain.controller.DomainController
public class DomainController extends Object
Central domain controller that manages the business logic of the application. Implements the Singleton pattern to ensure a unique instance. Coordinates operations related to Hidatos, users, and game sessions.

      public static DomainController getInstance(DataManager<Hidato,UUID> hidatoManager, DataManager<GameSession,UUID> gameSessionManager, DataManager<User,String> userManager, DataListManager<Hidato,UUID> hidatoListManager, DataListManager<GameSession,UUID> gameSessionListManager)
      Gets the DomainController instance and initializes the persistence managers. Can only be called once; subsequent calls throw an exception.

      Returns:
      The initialized singleton instance of DomainController
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if persistence managers have already been configured

    • generateHidato

      public String generateHidato(String dif)
      Generates a new Hidato randomly and stores it. Randomly selects a topology, adjacency type and number of cells. The number of cells ranges from 3 to 200.
      Parameters:
      dif - The desired difficulty level: "EASY", "MEDIUM", or "HARD"
      Returns:
      A string representing the generated Hidato with its topology and content

    • generateHidato

      public String generateHidato(String topology, String Adja, String dif, int nC)
      Generates a new Hidato with full control over topology, adjacency, difficulty and cell count.
      Parameters:
      topology - The board shape: "Squares", "Triangles", or "Hexagons"
      Adja - The adjacency type: "Sides" or "Sides + Vertices"
      dif - The desired difficulty level: "EASY", "MEDIUM", or "HARD"
      nC - The requested number of cells (between 3 and 200)
      Returns:
      A string representing the generated Hidato, or null if generation failed

    • makeSolvable

      public String makeSolvable(String hidato, String dif, int nC)
      Converts a Hidato into a solvable version by applying specified difficulty criteria. Stores the solvable Hidato in the persistence layer. Hides cells according to the difficulty level and requested number of cells.
      Parameters:
      hidato - String containing the complete Hidato
      dif - Difficulty level: "EASY", "MEDIUM", or "HARD"
      nC - Number of cells of the hidato
      Returns:
      String representing the solvable Hidato, or null if it could not be created

    • isSolution

      public boolean isSolution(String hidato)
      Verifies whether a Hidato is a valid solution. Checks that there is a correct path from the cell containing the value 1 to the cell containing the biggest value.
      Parameters:
      hidato - String containing the Hidato representation to verify
      Returns:
      true if the Hidato is a valid solution, false otherwise

    • getHidatoLabels

      public Map<String,String> getHidatoLabels(String listName)
      Returns a map of UUID string to human-readable label for every Hidato in the given list. The label format is: "Topology · Rows x Cols (shortUUID...)"
      Parameters:
      listName - The name of the Hidato list to retrieve labels for.
      Returns:
      A map where each key is the Hidato UUID string and each value is its readable label. Returns an empty map if the list does not exist or contains no valid Hidatos.
